question: [Chargeback] Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions
answer: Question Answer 1. What is credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute is initiated when a cardholder raises a dispute with their payment provider (e.g. a bank) regarding a transaction made through Touch 'n Go eWallet platform Cardholders may dispute the charges if they believe the transaction was unauthorised or fraudulent. 2. Why are account or card feature restrictions implemented during the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? To protect all users and the integrity of Touch 'n Go eWallet platform we will implement temporary account or specific feature restrictions while we thoroughly investigate the dispute, deterring additional disputes and adhering to industry regulations. 3. How long does the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute process take? We aim to resolve each dispute efficiently while ensuring a thorough investigation. Resolution times may vary depending on factors such as the complexity of the case. However, the cardholder may reach out to the payment provider to urge for the investigation outcome. 4. Can I still access my funds during the account restriction period? It depends on the type of restriction: If there is a complete eWallet account restriction, you will not be able to access your eWallet account. If only certain features are restricted, reloading using debit/prepaid/credit card is disabled. However, you can still reload your eWallet using alternative methods such as a reload PIN or DuitNow transfer. 5. Why do I need to pay for the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute amount? If the investigation reveals that the disputed transaction was not due to the fault of the merchant, the user is responsible for reimbursing the disputed or charged-back amounts to Touch 'n Go eWallet .

question: [Security and Privacy] Changing Devices for TapSecure
answer: Changing Devices? No Worries! If you ever switch devices, don't fret! Our eWallet app has got you covered. When you switch to a new device, simply follow these steps: Open the eWallet app on your new device. The app will prompt you to update and link your account to the new device. Alternatively, you can go to Settings and select "Link To This Device" to proceed. Forgot Your 6-Digit PIN? Not a Problem! We understand how it happens, and we've made it super easy to reset your 6-digit PIN. Just follow these simple steps: Locate the red rectangle box below. Tap on it to initiate the PIN reset process. Follow the on-screen instructions, and you'll have a new PIN in no time! We hope the above information helps. If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team by submitting a request here by selecting the Support Type as 'Registration/Login'.

question: [Account Management] What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended?
answer: Important Note! In certain scenarios, if your account has been suspended due to exceeding allowable 6-digit PIN attempts during login or exceeding allowable security questions attempts, please be patient and allow 24 hours before attempting again. If you are no longer logged-in : 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and enter your Registered Mobile Number . 2. Tap Forgot your PIN? 3. Enter your Mobile Number. 4. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your Mobile Number. 5. A message will appear once your 6 digit PIN has been successfully updated. If you are still logged-in : 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and tap Profile . 2. Tap Security . 3. Tap Change 6 digit PIN. 4. Enter Current 6 digit PIN. 5. Enter New 6 digit PIN. 6. A message will appear once your 6 digit PIN has been successfully updated. We hope the above information helps. If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team by submitting a request here by selecting the Support Type as ' 6-digits PIN/Security Question '.

question: [GO+] How long does it take for the Cash Out to be paid to my Touch 'n Go eWallet and bank account?
answer: A Cash Out request will be captured in the GO+ dashboard transaction details. If you Cash Out to : Your Touch 'n Go eWallet, the money will be credited instantly Your bank account, the money will be transferred within two business day from your transaction date (T+1) from the successful processing of your Cash Out request if the request is made before 4:00 PM (T). However, if the request is made at or after 4:00 PM (T), it will be treated as a next day request and the money will be transferred within three business days (T+2) from the successful processing of your Cash Out request. You will have to bear the applicable bank fees and charges. However, you may want to check your bank account first as occasionally money has been transferred into your bank account but TNGD will only update the status upon receiving confirmation from the bank 1 day later. Upon the first successful Cash Out to your bank account, as soon as the name of your eWallet and bank account matches (status: verified), you will see a verified tag and your subsequent Cash out request will take 2 calendar days (T+1) to complete processing. Facilitate payment to TNGD merchants, the Cash Out amount will be debited immediately from your GO+ balance.

question: What is an Unauthorised Transaction Report?
answer: An Unauthorised Transaction Report lets you tell us if there's a transaction in your TNG eWallet that you did not make or approve. It's our way of protecting you. Once we receive your completed report and all the required documents, we will start an investigation and update you on the results within 14 days. If we confirm that the transaction was not made by you and not related to a scam , you will get a full refund. At TNG Digital, your security is our top priority. Submit a report or learn more here

question: How long will the investigation take, and how will I be updated?
answer: We will complete the investigation and update you with the outcome within 14 days after receiving your completed report and documents. We'll keep you updated by email, so do check your inbox regularly. If the case is in your favour, we'll refund the full amount directly into your TNG eWallet. Your safety and peace of mind matter to us - and we'll do our best to keep you informed every step of the way.

question: Can I report the same transaction to National Scam Response Centre (NSRC)?
answer: Yes, but timing is important. The NSRC is best for immediate help if you've just realised you've been scammed. You must contact them within 24 hours of the incident as this increases the chances of stopping the money from going further. You can call 997 , the NSRC hotline, which is open daily from 8am to 8pm. Be ready with details such as your name, mobile number, date and time of the transaction, and amount involved. Please note: If you've already submitted a report to NSRC for the same transaction, you don't need to submit another report to us. One report per case is enough

question: Can I still report if the unauthorised transaction happened more than 90 days ago?
answer: We understand how stressful it is to discover a suspicious transaction. But to properly investigate, the report must be made within 90 days from when the transaction happened.

question: Can I submit an Unauthorised Transaction Report if I was tricked into making the transaction?
answer: We're very sorry if you've experienced a scam. It can be a painful and confusing experience. However, there is a difference between unauthorised transactions and scams. An unauthorised transaction means someone accessed your eWallet and made a transaction without your knowledge or approval. A scam means you were misled or tricked into approving the transaction yourself, for example by clicking on a fake link or talking to a scammer. Example of a scam: You made a payment to a seller because you believe he is genuine but did not receive the goods or services you paid for. If the investigation shows that you approved the transaction, even if you were tricked, it's not considered unauthorised and not eligible for a refund . You can still report scam cases to us using our Phishing Report Form or Scam Report Form . You should also call NSRC at 997 immediately (within 24 hours) to get further help. To learn more about the scenarios that are excluded from our Unauthorised Transactions Report Policy, please refer to our Terms & Conditions .

question: What are the requirements to submit an Unauthorised Transaction Report?
answer: You can submit an Unauthorised Transaction Report if: The unauthorised transaction happened on your own TNG eWallet account You're reporting within 90 days of the unauthorised transaction You have submitted all the required documents and information for us to conduct a thorough investigation. If all these are met, we'll be able to investigate your report thoroughly. Submit a report or learn more here .

question: What is TNG eWallet EV Charging and how does it work?
answer: EV Charging on TNG eWallet lets you charge your electric car easily and conveniently at selected locations. How it works: Step 1: Park your car at the charging spot and make sure your phone has a stable internet connection. Step 2: Launch your TNG eWallet, find EV Charging icon and tap on it. Step 3: Find your charging location - you can search via map view or list view. Step 4: Select your charger or simply scan the QR code on the charger. Step 5: Plug the charger securely into your car. Make sure nothing is blocking the charger or socket. Step 6: Tap "Next" when ready - your car will start charging. Step 7: To stop charging, swipe "Slide to Stop Charging", then unplug the charger from your car. Step 8: You'll receive a confirmation once charging ends. The charging cost will be deducted automatically, and a receipt will appear in EV Charging.

question: What can I do if the charging session does not start?
answer: If your charging session does not start, please follow these steps to troubleshoot the issue: Check the cable. Ensure the charger is securely plugged into both your car and the charging station. Push it in firmly if needed. Check your internet connection. Make sure your phone has a stable internet connection. Restart the session. Fully close the TNG eWallet app, open it again, refresh the EV Charging mini program, and try to start charging once more. Look for error messages. Check the app or charger screen for any alerts or instructions. Try another charger. If possible, switch to a different charging point to see if the issue persists. Still not working? Contact TNG eWallet via Chat here. Share the charger ID, your vehicle model, and a brief description of the issue.

question: The charging session stopped unexpectedly. What can I do?
answer: If your charging session stops unexpectedly, first check the EV Charging mini program for any error messages or alerts. Make sure the charging gun is properly connected to your car. If the problem continues, end the current session in the app and try using a different charger.

question: My vehicle is not connecting to the charger even when the charger gun is attached correctly. What should I do?
answer: Some electric vehicle models may occasionally experience this issue. We recommend trying a different available charger and starting a new charging session. Alternatively, you can disconnect the charger from your vehicle, reconnect it, and attempt to start the session again.

question: I am unable to stop the charge session from EV Charging mini program. What should I do?
answer: If the EV Charging mini program is unable to stop your charging session, you can stop the session using your vehicle's stop function. Please refer to your vehicle's instruction manual for guidance. Only perform an emergency stop if both the app and vehicle stop fail. Follow the instructions on the charger to carry out an emergency stop, and remove the charger gun from your vehicle when it is safe. Please reach out to us via this chat and we will investigate further. question: What should I do if EV Charging mini program doesn't show nearby charging stations?
answer: Ensure your device's location services are enabled and TNG eWallet has permission to access your location. If the issue persists, try refreshing the app.

question: Why is TNG eWallet asking me to verify my card?
answer: We need to confirm that the card you use to reload your eWallet belongs to you. Visa and Mastercard now require all merchants that accept their debit and credit cards to include additional cardholder details when processing reloads or top-ups. If the card does not belong to you, please select "It's someone else's card" on the pop-up and provide the information requested.

question: Why must I verify my saved cards on TNG eWallet?
answer: Visa and Mastercard require us to confirm card ownership and provide additional details about the cardholder when you reload your TNG eWallet. Verifying your saved card helps us meet this requirement and ensures your transactions remain secure.

question: How soon must I verify my saved card(s)?
answer: A pop-up on your TNG eWallet home screen will show how many days you have left to verify your saved primary card. Be sure to complete the verification before the countdown ends to avoid any interruptions when reloading using your debit or credit card. Topping up your eWallet via DuitNow Transfer and reload PINs remain unaffected.

question: Who must verify their saved card? Is it required by everyone?
answer: All users with a saved Mastercard/Visa card will need to verify their cards.

question: What information do I need to provide if "It's my card" that's saved on TNG eWallet?
answer: If the saved card belongs to you, no further information is required. Just click "It's my card" to proceed.

question: What will happen if I choose the "It's someone else's card" option?
answer: Select "It's someone else's card" if the card does not belong to you. You'll be asked to provide a few details about the cardholder before you can continue with your transaction.

question: What is Touch 'n Go Consumer Portal?
answer: The Touch 'n Go Consumer Portal is a shared platform for Touch 'n Go and TNG eWallet users. It allows you to view, manage, and track your transactions across your eWallet, Touch 'n Go Cards, and RFID tags in one place.

question: How do I log in to the Touch 'n Go Consumer Portal?
answer: To log in, follow these steps: Visit https://consumer.touchngo.com.my and scan the QR code on the homepage using your eWallet Enter your 6-digit eWallet PIN. Complete the facial recognition verification You will be logged in successfully

question: What features or information can I access on the Touch 'n Go Consumer Portal?
answer: The portal lets you view information and manage your TNG eWallet, RFID tag, and Touch 'n Go Cards. Here's an overview of what you can do for each: TNG eWallet Check your eWallet and GO+ balances View your transaction history for the past 90 days View all RFID tags and Touch 'n Go Cards linked to your eWallet RFID tag Access your dashboard and usage reports, including transaction summaries and most frequent tolls View linked RFID tags and vehicle details Download your RFID transaction history Request refunds for inaccurate charges or penalties Request RFID replacement or termination Touch 'n Go Card Access your dashboard and usage reports for transit, tolls, and parking View your card details Download transaction history, including PayDirect transactions Request refunds or terminate cards for issues like missing reloads or overcharges

question: Can I update my TNG eWallet profile via the Consumer Portal?
answer: No, profile updates must be made directly in the TNG eWallet app for security reasons. For step-by-step guidance, visit the support page here .

question: Can I link an enhanced Touch 'n Go Card to my TNG eWallet from the Consumer Portal?
answer: The enhanced Touch 'n Go Card can only be added via the TNG eWallet app using NFC on your device. Once the card is added and linked, you will be able to view its information in your Consumer Portal.

question: Will RFID tags and Touch 'n Go Cards added to my eWallet appear in the Consumer Portal?
answer: Yes. Any RFID tags or Touch 'n Go Cards you add through your TNG eWallet will appear in the Consumer Portal in real time. If you remove a card from your TNG eWallet, it will also be removed from the portal. If you don't see the updates right away, try logging out and back in. If the issue persists, please contact us at careline@touchngo.com.my for assistance.

question: What is TNG eWallet SOS Balance?
answer: SOS Balance is an exclusive feature designed for our loyal TNG eWallet users, currently available for toll payments only. It ensures you're never stuck at critical moments due to insufficient eWallet balance, covering essential payments on your behalf. Best of all, there are no additional fees to enjoy this benefit. Simply reload your eWallet within 24 hours and any outstanding SOS Balance will be automatically deducted. More services will be added to SOS Balance soon, making this feature even more rewarding and convenient. Learn More

answer: You can access SOS Balance from the: "Car" icon at the top of your eWallet home screen SOS Balance outstanding message on the home screen "More" option under "My Favourites", then type "SOS Balance" in the search bar

question: How do I enable TNG eWallet SOS Balance feature?
answer: SOS Balance is automatically enabled for our loyal TNG eWallet users-there's no need to opt in. If you're eligible, you'll receive a push notification letting you know that SOS Balance is now available to you. You can also check your eligibility by tapping the SOS Balance icon or the car icon at the top of your eWallet for confirmation.

question: How do I qualify for TNG eWallet's SOS Balance?
answer: SOS Balance is exclusively offered to our most loyal users. To increase your chances of eligibility, you will need to consistently demonstrate the following: a) Clearing all outstanding payments promptly b) Add money frequently to your eWallet c) Actively using their eWallet for transactions

question: I am eligible for SOS Balance, but SOS Balance did not work when I passed through a toll. Why?
answer: There are a few reasons why SOS Balance might not have been triggered: Toll plaza not supported You may have entered a toll plaza that does not currently support RFID or PayDirect payments. For a complete list of eligible toll plazas, please refer here . Sufficient eWallet balance If your eWallet balance was enough to cover the toll charge, SOS Balance wouldn't be triggered. PayDirect not enabled In order for SOS Balance to work you need to have RFID or PayDirect enabled on your eWallet. Your PayDirect may have been deactivated. To enable PayDirect for toll and parking payments to be automatically deducted from your eWallet balance: Open your eWallet app and tap on the "TNG Card" icon Tap on the linked card, then the three dots to open the menu Check the status of PayDirect. If it's disabled, tap on PayDirect and toggle the button to enable Enter your 6-digit PIN to confirm If no card is linked, you'll need to link one. We recommend the enhanced Touch 'n Go card with NFC functionality, which allows you to reload your card directly from your eWallet for added convenience. To link a card, tap "Add Card" and follow the steps provided. You can link up to 15 cards to your eWallet account.

question: How does TNG eWallet SOS Balance work at tolls?
answer: SOS Balance works at either Touch 'n Go RFID or PayDirect enabled toll plazas. It activates automatically when your eWallet balance is low, ensuring seamless toll payments. It covers the payment on behalf of eligible users passing through tolls with Touch 'n Go RFID tag or PayDirect deduction. Users have a 24-hour grace period to clear any outstanding SOS Balance amount to continue enjoying the feature. Best of all, there's no fee for this service. Note: SOS Balance is available exclusively for selected TNG eWallet users. To check your eligibility status, launch your eWallet and tap on SOS Balance.

question: What is e-Invoice?
answer: A digital receipt that serves as proof of transaction between suppliers and buyers. It includes: Supplier and buyer information Item descriptions, quantities, and prices It is formatted in a structured, machine-readable format specified by IRBM (e.g., XML or JSON), not as PDFs or images.

question: What are the benefits of e-Invoice?
answer: The implementation of e-Invoice offers numerous advantages, including: Minimises human errors through electronic data handling Speeds up invoicing processes Reduces operational costs through automation Makes financial data easier to manage and access.

question: Which party should issue the e-Invoice?

Inflation hedge Gold is considered an effective hedge against inflation, protecting against the decreased purchasing power of currency due to rising prices or inflation.

question: What is Zakat?

question: What is the "Zakat" feature?

answer: Know what you're paying for - With real-time FX conversion, transactions are transparent & hassle-free! question: What does the amount displayed in a foreign currency on my eWallet mean?
answer: The amount you see is an estimate of your combined eWallet and GO+ balances in the local currency, calculated using the current exchange rate from Alipay+ for the selected country. The actual conversion occurs at the time of your transaction. As with transactions in Malaysia, payments will first be deducted from your eWallet balance, and then from your GO+ balance if needed, providing a seamless and secure payment experience wherever you are.

question: Why do I see the option to switch countries from my eWallet home screen? What does that do?
answer: The option to switch countries on your eWallet home screen is provided because your eWallet can be used for payments overseas. This country toggle feature allows you to: Preview your balance: View your estimated eWallet balance in the local currency of the selected country using current exchange rate from Alipay+ for the selected country. Access travel benefits: Gain access to travel tips, exclusive deals, and vouchers that you can redeem in the selected country for added savings. This feature is useful both before your trip for planning and while you're abroad, helping you make transparent and convenient payments.

question: Does TNG eWallet charge a conversion fee for overseas transactions?
answer: Yes. Effective 25 April 2024, a 1% overseas transaction conversion fee will be included in the daily exchange rate of your travel destination. The sum that you're paying from the effective date is inclusive of this charge. The overseas transaction conversion fee is a market practise that is typically charged between 1% and 3% by banks and financial institutions. Despite the conversion fee, TNG eWallet Overseas QR Payment is still among the cheapest overseas payment options in the market.

question: What is Cashback Packet?

question: Who can receive Cashback Packet?

question: How much can users receive from a Cashback Packet?
answer: The amount is randomised by the system to each receiver.

question: How do I know if I have collected the Cashback Packet successfully?
answer: After tapping on the "Open Now" button (refer below), the amount received will be reflected in your eWallet balance (see Transaction History). A push notification will also be sent to you.

question: Is there a transaction record for claimed Cashback Packets?
answer: Yes, you can view from "Transaction History", which keeps a record of up to 90 days. You may also tap on "Filter", select "Others" and then "Cashback Packet" to narrow your search.

question: What happens if I don't open the Cashback Packet immediately upon receiving it?
answer: Once a Cashback Packet is dismissed, it is gone. You will not be able to open it later. Users are encouraged to open the Cashback Packet immediately upon receipt.
